external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A deployed sensor node installed at a customer site and publishing readings and polling for firmware updates.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway
external_entities.notes: The nodes are outside our physical control. The pre-shared key is per fleet, not per device, and has not been rotated since deployment.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.notes: The source does not state what authentication the console has, if any.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views telemetry dashboards.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker that accepts readings from sensor nodes and forwards them to Pub/Sub.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE
processes.notes: The fleet uses a pre-shared key to authenticate to the broker. The key is per fleet, not per device, and nobody has rotated it since deployment.

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer that picks up readings from Pub/Sub and writes them into the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

processes.name: dashboard
processes.description: A dashboard through which fleet operators view telemetry over BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used to check device keys and determine which customer a node belongs to.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A messaging store onto which the gateway forwards accepted readings.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing site addresses and occupancy patterns from the sensor fleet.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: firmware bucket
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket from which sensor nodes poll firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not say whether nodes verify a signature before installing an image.

data_flows.name: publish readings
data_flows.description: A sensor node publishes readings to the device gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway

data_flows.name: look up device
data_flows.description: The device gateway looks up a device in the device registry to check its key and identify its customer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_flows.name: forward readings
data_flows.description: The device gateway forwards accepted readings onto Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: pick up readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: write readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery
data_flows.data_description: sensor readings, including site addresses and occupancy patterns

data_flows.name: poll image
data_flows.description: A sensor node polls the firmware bucket for a new firmware image.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_flows.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not say whether the node checks a signature before installing the image.

data_flows.name: service node
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over its local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state what authentication the console has, if any.

data_flows.name: view dashboard
data_flows.description: A fleet operator views telemetry dashboards.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

data_flows.name: read telemetry
data_flows.description: The dashboard reads telemetry from BigQuery.
data_flows.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery

assumptions.assumption: The device gateway presents a non-web broker interface.
assumptions.basis: The source identifies it as an MQTT broker rather than a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry normalizer is a non-web process.
assumptions.basis: The source identifies it as a Python consumer rather than a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The dashboard presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source describes fleet operators looking at dashboards.

assumptions.assumption: The device registry contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains a device pre-shared key and the customer to which the device belongs.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that it contains site addresses and occupancy patterns and calls this customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The firmware bucket contains public data.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly states that the bucket is public read.
